enabled.description: Enable the google-guest-agent service. If false, the agent will not start.

log_level.description: Minimum log level to emit (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

log_dir.description: Directory where guest agent writes log files.

state_dir.description: Directory where guest agent stores persistent state (e.g., instance metadata cache).

daemons.description: List of optional daemons to run. Supported: guest-ssh, guest-oslogin, guest-account-manager, guest-oslogin-keysync. Set to empty list to run only core agent.

enable_scripts.description: Allow execution of custom scripts (e.g., startup, shutdown, metadata watch) from instance metadata.

enable_oslogin.description: Explicitly enable/disable OS login integration. If omitted, inferred from daemons (e.g., enabled if 'guest-oslogin' is in daemons).

enable_ssh_keys.description: Explicitly enable/disable SSH key management. If omitted, inferred from daemons (e.g., disabled if 'guest-ssh' omitted).

extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments to pass to the google-guest-agent binary (space-separated).

metadata_server_url.description: Override the default metadata server URL (e.g., for private Google access or testing).

api_endpoint.description: Override the default API endpoint (e.g., for VPC-SC or private.googleapis.com).

service_account_email.description: Use a specific service account email for token generation instead of the default instance service account.

watch_metadata_keys.description: List of additional metadata keys to watch for changes (triggers agent reload). Each key is a path like 'guest-configs/...' or 'ssh-keys'.
